read_parameters =: 3 : 0
    features =. y
    params =. 16$a:
    subsets =. 0$a:
    pairs =. 0 2$0
    for_box. read_lines 'input/params.txt' do.
        tokens =. words >box
        keyword =. 0{::tokens
        args =. }.tokens
        select. keyword
        case. 'PRIOR' do.
            params =. (0{args)0}params
        case. 'VAR_SMOOTHING' do.
            params =. (<decimal 0{::args)1}params
        case. 'SMOOTHING_GRID' do.
            params =. (<decimal&>args)2}params
        case. 'QDA_GAMMA' do.
            params =. (<decimal 0{::args)3}params
        case. 'GAMMA_GRID' do.
            params =. (<decimal&>args)4}params
        case. 'CV_FOLDS' do.
            params =. (<integer 0{::args)5}params
        case. 'CALIBRATION_EDGES' do.
            params =. (<decimal&>args)6}params
        case. 'REJECT_THRESHOLDS' do.
            params =. (<decimal&>args)7}params
        case. 'CURVE' do.
            params =. (<integer&>args)8}params
        case. 'OUTLIER_THRESHOLD' do.
            params =. (<decimal 0{::args)9}params
        case. 'BOOTSTRAP' do.
            params =. (<integer 0{::args)10}params
            params =. (<integer 1{::args)11}params
        case. 'MAP_SIZE' do.
            params =. (<integer&>args)12}params
        case. 'PLOT_SIZE' do.
            params =. (<integer&>args)13}params
        case. 'SUBSET' do.
            subsets =. subsets,<(<0{::args),<features i.}.args
        case. 'PAIR' do.
            pairs =. pairs,features i.args
        end.
    end.

read_inputs =: 3 : 0

    for_box. training do.
        row =. >box
        row =. (<classes i.<row_label row)3}row
        train =. train,<row
    end.
    for_box. testing do.
        row =. >box
        row =. (<classes i.<row_label row)3}row
        test_rows =. test_rows,<row
    end.
    costs =. ((#classes),#classes)$0.0
    lines =. read_lines 'input/costs.csv'
    columns =. }.csv_words 0{::lines
    order =. columns i.classes

        fields =. csv_words >box
        actual =. classes i.0{fields

        costs =. (order{values)actual}costs
    end.
    params =. read_parameters features
    (<features),(<classes),(<train),(<test_rows),(<costs),<params
)

sum_fractions =: 3 : 0
    result =. 0 1x

        value =. >box

        denominator =. (1{result)*1{value

measures =: 3 : 0
    'actual predicted count' =. y
    matrix =. (count,count)$0
    for_index. i.#actual do.
        location =. (index{actual),index{predicted
        matrix =. (1+(<location){matrix)(<location)}matrix
    end.
    support =. +/"1 matrix
    columns =. +/matrix
    correct =. 0
    recall =. 0$a:
    precision =. 0$a:
    f1 =. 0$a:
    expected =. 0x
    macro =. 0.0
    for_index. i.count do.
        diagonal =. (<index,index){matrix
        correct =. correct+diagonal
        recall =. recall,<diagonal reduced_fraction index{support
        precision =. precision,<diagonal reduced_fraction index{columns
        f1 =. f1,<(2*diagonal)reduced_fraction (index{support)+index{columns
        expected =. expected+(index{support)*index{columns
        macro =. macro+(2.0*diagonal)%(index{support)+index{columns
    end.
    total =. sum_fractions recall
    amount =. #actual
    accuracy =. correct reduced_fraction amount
    balanced =. (0{total)reduced_fraction count*1{total
    kappa =. ((amount*correct)-expected)reduced_fraction (amount*amount)-expected
    (<matrix),(<support),(<correct),(<accuracy),(<balanced),(<kappa),(<recall),(<precision),(<f1),<macro%count
)

mcnemar =: 3 : 0
    'actual first second' =. y
    correct_first =. actual=first
    correct_second =. actual=second
    b01 =. +/correct_first*.-.correct_second
    b10 =. +/correct_second*.-.correct_first
    chi =. 0.0
    if. b01~:b10 do.
        difference =. (|b01-b10)-1
        chi =. (0.0+difference*difference)%b01+b10
    end.
    b01,b10,chi,chi>3.841
)

class_statistics =: 3 : 0
    'rows features count' =. y
    size =. #features
    groups =. count$<(0,size)$0.0
    vectors =. (0,size)$0.0
    for_box. rows do.
        row =. >box
        vector =. features{row_values row
        vectors =. vectors,vector
        category =. row_class row
        group =. category{::groups
        groups =. (<group,vector)category}groups
    end.
    counts =. i.0
    means =. (0,size)$0.0
    scatter =. (0,size,size)$0.0
    for_category. i.count do.
        group =. category{::groups
        counts =. counts,#group
        mean =. size$0.0
        for_feature. i.size do.
            total =. ordered_sum feature{"1 group
            mean =. (total%#group)feature}mean
        end.
        means =. means,mean
        matrix =. zeros size
        for_first. i.size do.
            for_second. i.size do.
                total =. 0.0
                for_vector. group do.
                    total =. total+((first{vector)-first{mean)*((second{vector)-second{mean)
                end.
                matrix =. total (<first,second)}matrix
            end.
        end.
        scatter =. scatter,,:(matrix)
    end.
    center =. size$0.0
    variances =. size$0.0
    for_feature. i.size do.
        average =. (ordered_sum feature{"1 vectors)%#rows
        center =. average feature}center
        total =. 0.0
        for_vector. vectors do.
            delta =. (feature{vector)-average
            total =. total+delta*delta
        end.
        variances =. (total%#rows)feature}variances
    end.
    pooled =. zeros size
    for_first. i.size do.
        for_second. i.size do.
            total =. 0.0
            for_category. i.count do.
                total =. total+(<category,first,second){scatter
            end.
            pooled =. (total%((#rows)-count))(<first,second)}pooled
        end.
    end.
    (<#rows),(<counts),(<means),(<scatter),(<center),(<variances),<pooled
)

train_model =: 3 : 0
    'name features rows count prior_mode epsilon gamma' =. y
    stats =. class_statistics (<rows),(<features),<count
    size =. #features
    means =. s_means stats
    counts =. s_counts stats
    scatter =. s_scatter stats
    maximum_variance =. >./s_variances stats
    added =. epsilon*maximum_variance
    priors =. count$0.0
    covariances =. (0,size,size)$0.0
    factors =. (0,size,size)$0.0
    determinants =. 0$0.0
    for_category. i.count do.
        prior =. 1.0%count
        if. prior_mode-:'empirical' do.
            prior =. (0.0+category{counts)%#rows
        end.
        priors =. prior category}priors
        covariance =. zeros size
        for_first. i.size do.
            for_second. i.size do.
                value =. 0.0
                if. name-:'LDA' do.
                    value =. (<first,second){s_pooled stats
                elseif. name-:'NB' do.
                    if. first=second do.
                        value =. (((<category,first,second){scatter)%category{counts)+added
                    end.
                else.
                    value =. ((<category,first,second){scatter)%(category{counts)-1
                    if. first~:second do.
                        value =. value*(1.0-gamma)
                    end.
                end.
                covariance =. value (<first,second)}covariance
            end.
        end.
        factor =. cholesky covariance
        covariances =. covariances,,:(covariance)
        factors =. factors,,:(factor)
        determinants =. determinants,log_determinant factor
    end.
    log_priors =. ^.priors
    normalizer =. (size*^.2.0*3.141592653589793)%2.0
    (<name),(<features),(<stats),(<means),(<priors),(<covariances),(<factors),(<determinants),(<log_priors),(<normalizer),(<epsilon),(<gamma),(<maximum_variance),<added
)

model_scores =: 4 : 0
    distances =. x squared_distances y
    priors =. g_log_priors x
    determinants =. g_log_determinants x
    normalizer =. g_normalizer x
    result =. 0$0.0
    for_category. i.#distances do.
        score =. (((category{priors)-normalizer)-((category{determinants)%2.0))-((category{distances)%2.0)
        result =. result,score
    end.
    result
)

infer_vector =: 4 : 0
    'point costs' =. y
    scores =. x model_scores point
    predicted =. argmax scores
    maximum =. predicted{scores
    exponentials =. ^scores-maximum
    total =. ordered_sum exponentials
    posterior =. exponentials%total
    log_posterior =. (scores-maximum)-^.total
    decision =. predicted
    if. #costs do.
        risks =. 0$0.0
        for_decided. i.#scores do.
            risk =. 0.0
            for_category. i.#scores do.
                risk =. risk+(category{posterior)*(<category,decided){costs
            end.
            risks =. risks,risk
        end.
        decision =. argmin risks
    end.
    (<predicted),(<posterior),(<log_posterior),(< >./posterior),<decision
)

cholesky =: 3 : 0
    lower =. zeros #y
    for_row. i.#y do.
        for_column. i.row+1 do.
            subtotal =. 0.0
            for_index. i.column do.
                subtotal =. subtotal+((<row,index){lower)*(<column,index){lower
            end.
            remainder =. ((<row,column){y)-subtotal
            if. row=column do.
                value =. %:remainder
            else.
                value =. remainder%(<column,column){lower
            end.
            lower =. value (<row,column)}lower
        end.
    end.
    lower
)
forward =: 4 : 0
    lower =. x
    result =. (#lower)$0.0
    for_row. i.#lower do.
        subtotal =. 0.0
        for_index. i.row do.
            subtotal =. subtotal+((<row,index){lower)*index{result
        end.
        value =. ((row{y)-subtotal)%(<row,row){lower
        result =. value row}result
    end.
    result
)
backward =: 4 : 0
    lower =. x
    size =. #lower
    result =. size$0.0
    for_row. |.i.size do.
        subtotal =. 0.0
        for_index. (row+1)+i.size-(row+1) do.
            subtotal =. subtotal+((<index,row){lower)*index{result
        end.
        value =. ((row{y)-subtotal)%(<row,row){lower
        result =. value row}result
    end.
    result
)
log_determinant =: 3 : 0
    total =. 0.0
    for_index. i.#y do.
        total =. total+^.(<index,index){y
    end.
    2*total
)
quadratic =: 4 : 0
    transformed =. x forward y
    transformed dot transformed
)
jacobi =: 3 : 0
    size =. #y
    current =. y
    vectors =. zeros size
    for_index. i.size do.
        vectors =. 1.0 (<index,index)}vectors
    end.
    sweeps =. 0
    while. 1 do.
        off =. 0.0
        for_first. i.size-1 do.
            for_second. (first+1)+i.size-(first+1) do.
                value =. (<first,second){current
                off =. off+value*value
            end.
        end.
        if. ((%:off)<1e_12)+.sweeps=50 do.
            break.
        end.
        for_first. i.size-1 do.
            for_second. (first+1)+i.size-(first+1) do.
                value =. (<first,second){current
                if. value=0.0 do.
                    continue.
                end.
                theta =. (((<second,second){current)-(<first,first){current)%2*value
                sign =. 1.0
                if. theta<0.0 do.
                    sign =. _1.0
                end.
                tangent =. sign%(|theta)+%:(theta*theta)+1.0
                cosine =. 1.0%%:(tangent*tangent)+1.0
                sine =. tangent*cosine
                for_index. i.size do.
                    if. (index~:first)*.index~:second do.
                        horizontal =. (<index,first){current
                        vertical =. (<index,second){current
                        a =. (cosine*horizontal)-sine*vertical
                        b =. (sine*horizontal)+cosine*vertical
                        current =. a (<index,first)}current
                        current =. a (<first,index)}current
                        current =. b (<index,second)}current
                        current =. b (<second,index)}current
                    end.
                end.
                value =. (<first,second){current
                current =. (((<first,first){current)-tangent*value)(<first,first)}current
                current =. (((<second,second){current)+tangent*value)(<second,second)}current
                current =. 0.0 (<first,second)}current
                current =. 0.0 (<second,first)}current
                for_index. i.size do.
                    horizontal =. (<index,first){vectors
                    vertical =. (<index,second){vectors
                    vectors =. ((cosine*horizontal)-sine*vertical)(<index,first)}vectors
                    vectors =. ((sine*horizontal)+cosine*vertical)(<index,second)}vectors
                end.
            end.
        end.
        sweeps =. sweeps+1
    end.
    values =. 0$0.0
    for_index. i.size do.
        values =. values,(<index,index){current
    end.
    (<values),(<vectors),<sweeps
)

cv_with =: 3 : 0
    key =. y
    'name sequence epsilon gamma' =. key
    for_box. CVCache do.
        record =. >box
        if. key-:4{.record do.
            4}.record return.
        end.
    end.
    predicted =. N$0
    fold_correct =. i.0
    for_fold. i.p_folds Params do.
        retained =. Training#~Folds~:fold
        fitted =. fit (<name),(<sequence),(<retained),(<p_prior Params),(<epsilon),<gamma
        correct =. 0

            row =. index{::Training

model_sections =: 3 : 0
    'nb lda qda' =. MainModels
    stats =. g_statistics nb
    means =. s_means stats
    counts =. s_counts stats
    sections =. 0$a:
    lines =. (<'features ',' 'join Features),(<'classes ',' 'join Classes),<'prior_mode ',p_prior Params
    for_category. i.ClassCount do.
        lines =. lines,<'class ',(category{::Classes),' letter ',(category{UpperLetters),' count ',(text category{counts),' prior ',(real_text category{g_priors nb),' mean ',reals category{means
    end.
    sections =. sections,<lines
    lines =. (<'model NB'),<'smoothing epsilon ',(real_text g_epsilon nb),' max_variance ',(real_text g_max_variance nb),' added ',real_text g_added nb
    for_category. i.ClassCount do.
        covariance =. category{g_covariances nb
        diagonal =. 0$0.0
        for_feature. i.D do.
            diagonal =. diagonal,(<feature,feature){covariance
        end.
        lines =. lines,<'class ',(category{::Classes),' variance ',(reals diagonal),' log_det ',real_text category{g_log_determinants nb
    end.
    sections =. sections,<lines
    factor =. 0{g_factors lda
    lines =. (<'model LDA'),<'log_det ',real_text 0{g_log_determinants lda
    for_row. 0{g_covariances lda do.
        lines =. lines,<'  ',reals row
    end.
    for_category. i.ClassCount do.
        mean =. category{g_means lda
        coefficients =. factor backward factor forward mean
        intercept =. (^.category{g_priors lda)-(mean dot coefficients)%2.0
        lines =. lines,<'class ',(category{::Classes),' intercept ',(real_text intercept),' coef ',reals coefficients
    end.
    sections =. sections,<lines
    lines =. <'model QDA gamma ',real_text g_gamma qda
    for_category. i.ClassCount do.
        covariance =. category{g_covariances qda
        'values vectors sweeps' =. jacobi covariance
        values =. \:~values
        condition =. ({.values)%{:values
        lines =. lines,<'class ',(category{::Classes),' log_det ',(real_text category{g_log_determinants qda),' eigenvalues ',(reals values),' condition ',real_text condition
        for_row. covariance do.
            lines =. lines,<'  ',reals row
        end.
    end.
    sections =. sections,<lines
    lines =. <'separation'
    for_first. i.ClassCount-1 do.
        for_second. (first+1)+i.ClassCount-(first+1) do.
            delta =. (first{means)-second{means
            mahalanobis =. %:factor quadratic delta
            average =. ((first{g_covariances qda)+second{g_covariances qda)%2.0
            average_factor =. cholesky average
            determinants =. g_log_determinants qda
            quadratic_term =. (average_factor quadratic delta)%8.0
            average_determinant =. ((first{determinants)+second{determinants)%2.0
            determinant_term =. ((log_determinant average_factor)-average_determinant)%2.0
            bhattacharyya =. quadratic_term+determinant_term
            lines =. lines,<(first{::Classes),' ',(second{::Classes),' mahalanobis ',(real_text mahalanobis),' bhattacharyya ',real_text bhattacharyya
        end.
    end.
    sections =. sections,<lines
    outliers =. 0 2$0.0
    for_index. i.N do.
        row =. index{::Training
        distance =. (row_class row){qda model_distances row_values row
